notes.title: About Bug fix, future updates and some memes
notes.notes:
We apperciate every player's feedback. Thanks for playing.

1. Next update will be in two weeks. During this period, any bug report is welcomed. We will fix them ASAP.
2. We noticed that there are many German and Russian players, and we are considering provide more localization support.
3. More cubes? More levels? You can leave comments and give us some suggestions. 

Finally, here are some memes. Have a great day with our little robot~
